name: suno-band-manager
description: AI-powered music production assistant for creating Suno-ready song packages — a BMad Method module, created with BMad.

interface.shortDescription: Mac, a band manager agent, and five skills that build Suno-ready song packages.
interface.longDescription: Mac remembers you, your bands and your songs, and orchestrates the band profile manager, style prompt builder, lyric transformer, feedback elicitor and playlist sequencer into complete Suno packages: style prompt, structured lyrics and settings. A BMad Method module, created with BMad.
